headline: Praktiker stores in Greece become Dedeman. The Pavăl brothers have begun renovating the 17 stores and are preparing products from Romania
summary: Praktiker is leaving Greece after 35 years, and its stores will carry the Dedeman name. Owners Dragoș and Adrian Pavăl have started renovating the stores and plan to bring Romanian-made products to Greece.
why: Praktiker is a home-improvement retailer, and this transaction shows cross-border retail consolidation in southeastern Europe.
